---
description: "Use when creating or editing Python files in this repository. Defines the 140-character line-length limit and wrapping policy."
applyTo: "**/*.py"
---

# Python formatting

- Keep Python lines at or below 140 characters.
- Keep statements and function signatures on one line when they fit within 140 characters; do not wrap early to satisfy a shorter default limit.
- When a line exceeds 140 characters, wrap at logical boundaries using parentheses.
- Apply this policy to new and edited code without reformatting unrelated code.
